rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for an organization’s rules governing members’ conduct.

example.english: Our company has a regulation that doesn't allow employees to smoke in the office.
example.traditional: 我哋公司有條規則，唔准員工喺辦公室食煙。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 tiu4 kwai1 zak1 m4 zeon2 jyun4 gung1 hai2 baan6 gung1 sat1 sik6 jin1

rows.note: Use this for an official regulation, especially one issued by a government or organization.

example.english: The government's new regulation will take effect next month.
example.traditional: 政府新出嘅規例，下個月開始生效。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 san1 ceot1 ge3 kwai1 lai6 haa6 go3 jyut6 hoi1 ci2 sang1 haau6
